article.headline: Moncrief's 25 lead Saint Francis past Le Moyne 81-76 in OT
article.description: — Chris Moncrief had 25 points in Saint Francis' (Pennsylvania) 81-76 overtime win over Le Moyne on Thursday night.
article.linkText: Moncrief's 25 lead Saint Francis past Le Moyne 81-76 in OT
article.story: SYRACUSE, N.Y. -- — Chris Moncrief had 25 points in Saint Francis' (Pennsylvania) 81-76 overtime win over Le Moyne on Thursday night. Moncrief also added six rebounds for the Red Flash (11-17, 6-8 Northeast Conference). Riley Parker scored 19 points while going 8 of 14 (3 for 7 from 3-point range) and added five rebounds and four steals. Daemar Kelly shot 4 for 11 and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line to finish with 14 points. AJ Dancier led the Dolphins (9-19, 4-9) in scoring, finishing with 30 points and four assists. Le Moyne also got 20 points from Deng Garang. Robby Carmody also had nine points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
